artifact: iteration 10 BASE-W: which weights hold the default algorithm

units.T10: connected components (primary): D = [' find'], A = [' dfs', ' bfs'], 20 prompts
units.B3: MST (beside): D = Kruskal-class tokens, A = Prim-class tokens, 20 prompts
units.G-GRID: Gemma-3-4b grid fork @32 (W3, descriptive): D = DFS class (' visited'), A = BFS class
units.T1_T2: descriptive only, 5 prompts, single-position margin (dropped first after W3)

S0.path: iteration 9 one-token path: cmap9.prefix_kv on ids[:-1], then a one-token forward of ids[-1] at a fixed batch shape B_ot (largest of 40, 24, 16, 8 that fits), row 0 read
S0.fallback: F1: on failure after 2 debug rounds, proceed on own captures (shares vs own m_I/m_B)

W1_TF.margin: m(h, rows) = lse(h @ rows[D].T) - lse(h @ rows[A].T), fp32; rms(h, g) mimics the bf16 Qwen3RMSNorm path (fp32 normalise, bf16 round, times g, bf16 round), eps 1e-6

arms.ROWS_ALL (PRIMARY): every S = D u A row = w_B,t
arms.ROWS_NORM: m(rms(h_pre_I, g_B), base S rows) = readout upper bound for the class margin
arms.FULL_UNEMB: all rows base; identical to ROWS_ALL for the margin by construction (kept for full-distribution metrics and generation)
arms.FACTORIAL_2x2: m_II = m_I, m_IB = ROWS_NORM, m_BI = m(rms(h_pre_B, g_I), W_I), m_BB = m_B; interaction = m_II - m_IB - m_BI + m_BB

nulls.rng: np.random.default_rng([seed, vocabulary row index]) per row
nulls.RAND_ISO: w_I,t + ||Delta_t|| u_t, u_t isotropic Gaussian normalised
nulls.DELTA_SWAP: w_I,t + Delta_s, s uniform among tokens with ||Delta_s|| within 5% of ||Delta_t||, ||w_I,s|| within 10% of ||w_I,t||, s not in S, decoded string (stripped, lowercased) containing none of the class strings; no repeats in a draw
nulls.RAND_RESID: u_t = random unit vector (isotropic) in the span of the top-64 principal components (centred) of the instruct h_fin over all prompt + opening positions of the unit's 20 prompts, scaled to ||Delta_t||

W1_TF.outcomes: share = ratio of sums (primary); mean/median of per-prompt ratios; prompts with gap < 0.5 flagged; 10000 prompt-bootstrap 95% CI (seed 20261024); per-token logit change h_fin_I . Delta_t; P(D), P(A), unmapped mass, entropy, JS and KL to the base fork distribution; nulls: distribution of the 50 shares, median, p95, max, empirical p = (1 + #draws >= observed) / 51

verdict_T10.SUPPORTED: share(ROWS_ALL) >= 0.5 AND median RAND_ISO <= 0.15 AND share(ROWS_ALL) > max RAND_ISO

W1_TF.specificity_qualifier: 'written into these tokens' own rows' requires share(ROWS_ALL) above the p95 of DELTA_SWAP and of RAND_RESID; otherwise 'readout-level but not token-specific'

W1_GEN.slots: 30 = W1-W5 x 6, slot s = 6*template_index + k, uniforms np.random.default_rng(9101 + s).random(MAX_NEW)
W1_GEN.batch: one batch of the template's 6 slots per arm at a fixed batch shape B = 6
W1_GEN.fork: fp32 full-vocabulary readout for every arm at the fork (TWIN included); later steps use the unmodified bf16 lm_head except ROWS_ALLSTEPS (S rows of the bf16 lm_head swapped in place, restored and asserted equal afterwards); FPD = base fp32 fork logits from S0
W1_GEN.FULL_UNEMB_FORK: run only if its fork distribution differs from ROWS by total variation > 0.05
W1_GEN.never_dropped: TWIN / ROWS / RAND_MED / FPD x 30 slots on T10
W1_GEN.label: frozen label_k3.py; correct DFS = label 'dfs' AND passes hidden tests (primary); B3 correct Prim = label in {prim_heap, prim_array} AND pass
W1_GEN.tests: exact two-sided McNemar on CRN pairs; primary ROWS vs TWIN and ROWS vs RAND_MED (Holm over 2); reported ROWS vs RAND_MAX, ROWS vs RAND_0, FPD vs TWIN, ROWS vs FPD; Wilson CIs for pass rates, Newcombe CIs for pass differences
W1_GEN.verdict: SUPPORTED if ROWS >= 10/30 correct DFS AND each RAND arm <= 3/30 AND both primary Holm p < 0.05
W1_GEN.predictions: COMMIT #2: 30 * mean over the 5 slot prompts of sum_tok p_arm(tok) P(class|tok)

W2.matching: Hungarian on |log N_l - log N_e|, N_l = sqrt(||dGate||^2 + ||dUp||^2 + ||dDown||^2); E_joint scaled by c = ||dW_late_joint|| / ||dW_early_joint||; committed (COMMIT #3) before any W2 forward
W2.scope_B_fork_only (bridge): base MLP on the live fork input (CPU fp32), singles 26..35, joint of the 10, iteration-9 joint of [26, 27, 28, 30, 32]; reproduction of iteration 9's W shares within +-0.05
W2.rule: share(W_late_joint) - share(E_joint) >= 0.15 with bootstrap CI excluding 0 AND share(W_late_joint) > max of the 3 RANDDELTA_joint draws
W2.decomposition: readout (ROWS_NORM); late MLPs all-position; joint DECOMP; interaction = joint - readout - late; remainder = 1 - joint

W3.untie: output only: logits for S tokens use the pt embedding rows; Gemma3RMSNorm gain (1 + w); final_logit_softcapping applied if non-null
